title: Sentinel Shield

sources.title: Shield Blow
markers: actually is a Strength saving throw

summary: Shield gives +2 AC, +3 Initiative and Advantage on Perception checks.

fields.Heightened Awareness: +3 Initiative and Advantage on Perception checks.
fields.Shield Blow: When hit by a melee attack, spend a Reaction. A Strength save against your spell save DC prevents Prone for 1 turn. The tooltip lists Dexterity, but the documented action uses Strength.
fields.Acquisition: Lann Tarv on the main floor at Moonrise Towers.
fields.Base value: 580 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay and acquisition details with pinned source evidence.
